pages.title: Look Calmly
pages.text: Use protection against stare provocation while respecting other Enderman threats.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Rare hoods come from Badlands, Snowy and Savanna Endermen. The native slot is chest; protection concerns stare provocation, not all attacks or universal invisibility.
